title: Binance Will Open Trading for Memecoin (MEME)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Memecoin (MEME) , and open trading for  MEME/BNB, MEME/USDT, MEME/FDUSD, MEME/TUSD and MEME/TRY  spot trading pairs at  2023-11-03 08:00 (UTC) .  In addition, Trading Bots services will be enabled for the MEME/USDT trading pair within 48 hours of the trading start time. Start Trading on Binance Spot Now!  Notes :  The  Seed Tag  will be applied to MEME. Users will enjoy  zero maker fees  on MEME/FDUSD and MEME/TUSD trading pairs until further notice. TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.   Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-11-02 Note: This announcement was last updated on 2023-11-03.
